expectations.text: States EN 18286:2026 (AI quality management, supporting Article 17) became the first AI Act harmonised standard cited in the OJEU, announced October 15, 2026
expectations.evidence: "EN 18286:2026 (AI quality management system, supporting Art. 17) became the first AI Act harmonised standard cited in the OJEU. It was announced on 15 October 2026."

expectations.text: Explains citation in the OJEU gives a presumption of conformity for the covered requirements
expectations.evidence: "Presumption of conformity (Art. 40). Applying a cited harmonised standard gives a presumption that you meet the corresponding requirements."

expectations.text: Notes the broader standardisation request deadline was revised to February 2027
expectations.evidence: "The deadline for the broader standardisation request was revised to February 2027."

expectations.text: Mentions further standards (such as risk management) are still in the pipeline
expectations.evidence: "prEN 18228 (risk management, supporting Art. 9) is in final approval but not yet cited."

expectations.text: States the high-risk application dates (December 2, 2027 for Annex III; August 2, 2028 for Annex I) run independently of standards progress
expectations.evidence: "Annex III standalone systems now apply from 2 December 2027, and Annex I embedded-product systems from 2 August 2028"; "Do not wait for standards to start."
